scope.folds: even train / odd test and reverse
scope.units: H3 nominal positional-bin centers, equivalent frame coordinates; not exact VAE receptive fields or detected action timings

interpretation: The tested shared template averages four training spatial probes at each reference time and transfers it to four different spatial probes. This cross-spatial generalization is the failed assumption being tested.
Nearest-template average absolute errors are30.70–31.11 nominal frames. Candidate sets contain29.48–29.86 of31 reference times on average;99.51–99.65% of heldout rows have multiple candidates.
Correct-time inclusion around99% is caused by broad candidate sets and is not useful temporal localization. Nonempty candidate sets span about101.1–101.2 of the102 nominal frame range on average.

No tested head/fold/step/reference branch has a positive discrete separation margin at any pre-enumerated time resolution using its training-LOO radius. This is a failed sufficient stability certificate for this empirical radius, not a mathematical proof of absence of all time information.

Minimum-norm linear readout strongly amplifies heldout probe differences; per-head/fold heldout RMSE medians405–561 nominal frames and large inverse gains agree with unstable cross-spatial transfer. No ridge or clipping was tuned afterwards.

The poor result is not solely a conservative-radius artifact: nearest-template errors also remain large. The evidence still does not separate spatial appearance, scene progress, role encoding and action information.

Schemes preserving probe identity/spatial correspondence were not tested. Cross-spatial invariance is not a necessary condition for every usable temporal readout. Other layers, probe placements, steps and features are outside this result.
next_step: Do not feed this shared reference template directly into alpha. Do not tune radius/ridge/head/step on this same result to recover a positive finding.
Keep the existing signed-phase readout HOLD decision and the old failed historical AV gate unchanged.
Wait for the separately authorized frozen field same-environment reproduction before selecting further model interventions.
Any future spatially matched readout requires a separate frozen hypothesis and identity/static/appearance counterexamples; this review does not authorize another GPU experiment.
